stage.title: Let the water through
stage.speaker: The mason
stage.motivation: The roof is mended. I need a washing sieve: fine grit and water must pass through, but the gravel must stay.
stage.travelText: We empty and bring the bucket we made to the mason’s spring yard.

things.description: A reusable rag loaded with pitch.

things.label: Bucket · watertight
things.description: The same stave bucket, with its seams sealed.

things.label: Gritty gravel
things.description: Coarse gravel mixed with fine grit. The mason wants the coarse pieces.

things.label: Hand drill
things.description: For making small holes in wood. The worker provides the skill and effort.

locations.label: Spring
locations.description: Running water for washing fine grit through a sieve. This is a compressed fictional workshop action.
